2005.why: It drew a bit more than the average car's complaints in its first 3 years, most about body structure.
2005.pln: a bit more than the average car's complaints
td: Body
Look underneath for rust, and check the doors, hood and hatch close and latch right.
Seats
Adjust each seat, try any heaters, and make sure they lock in place.
Wipers & visibility
Run the wipers, washers, defrost and mirror controls.
Tires
Check the tread is even across each tire, with no bulges, and note the tire date codes.

2006.why: It drew about one and a half times the average car's complaints in its first 3 years, most about body structure.
2006.pln: about one and a half times the average car's complaints
td: Body
Look underneath for rust, and check the doors, hood and hatch close and latch right.
Brakes
Brake firmly once at speed: it should stop straight, with no pulsing, grinding or brake warning light.
Tires
Check the tread is even across each tire, with no bulges, and note the tire date codes.
Airbags
The airbag light should come on at start, then go out and stay out.
Doors & locks
Lock and unlock every door from the fob and the switch, and open each one.
